newsitem.title: USA: Lamar to sell outdoor displays for $46.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Lamar to sell outdoor displays for $46.5 million.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co. said Wednesday it agreed to sell outdoor advertising displays, which it is acquiring from Penn Advertising Inc., to Universal Outdoor Inc. for $46.5 million in cash.
Lamar said it will sell about 1,450 displays in the Baltimore area to Universal, but will continue to operate 7,000 other displays in Penn's eight other markets.
On Monday, Lamar said it had a definitive agreement to buy Penn Advertising for $167 million in cash. The acquisition gives the company about 8,429 displays in the Eastern and Northeastern states.
Lamar owns outdoor advertising displays in Southeastern, Midwestern and mid-Atlantic states.
